title: Canada map: castle, mountains and trees
kaylee: Canada's map looks finished: the castle in Quebec City has real copper roofs, the mountains wear drippy snowcaps and the woods are fuller, with red and gold maples in the east.

pictures.title: The castle
pictures.caption: Its roofs stuck out sideways (a bug). Now: steep copper roofs, dormers, witch-hat turrets, a gold spire, a lamp-lit terrace.

pictures.title: The Rockies
pictures.caption: Each peak has a shoulder and a snowcap that drips down its edges; the range behind Lulu's lake is two peaks deep.

pictures.title: The woods
pictures.caption: Three-tier spruces, snow-tipped up north; fall maples in the eastern woods.

pictures.title: The whole map
pictures.caption: Still calm: big open land, the places stand out.

pictures.title: Jev 3D glitch check (72 frames, 9 screen sizes)
pictures.caption: Box 1, moose and tent 'in pieces': not a bug, friends overlap in the arrival close-up. Box 2, 'pale band' on iPhone: not a bug, the river's cream shore (unchanged). The 45 maybes I checked: the balloon and ice floes float by design, peaks and trees stand in the ground on purpose, shores are cream. Nothing to fix.
